inputs.model.prompt: A lone lighthouse on a black basalt island, huge slow waves exploding against the rocks in white spray. The camera drifts sideways past the lighthouse as its beam sweeps once through the sea fog, momentarily lighting the rain of droplets in the air. A flock of gulls scatters off the cliff edge into the wind. Cold blue-grey dawn light, one warm lamp glow in the tower window. Roaring surf, deep wind, a distant foghorn.
